# Population Embedding Qc

## Execution

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `bool` | `True` | `basic` | Enable population embedding and clustering QC when the stage is run. | - |

## Inputs

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_adata_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional input AnnData path; defaults to general.anndata_path. | - |

## Clustering selection

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `Literal['auto', 'single', 'sweep']` | `auto` | `basic` | Analysis mode: auto-detect available evidence, analyse one column, or require a Leiden sweep. | - |
| `population_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Reference population column; auto mode falls back to population, leiden, or the median sweep resolution. | - |
| `sweep_regex` | `str` | `^leiden_(?P<resolution>\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)$` | `advanced` | Regular expression used to detect precomputed Leiden sweep columns; it must expose a named resolution group. | - |
| `sweep_columns` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional explicit, numerically ordered Leiden sweep column list instead of regex discovery. | - |
| `reference_resolution` | `Optional[float]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional sweep resolution to use as the reference clustering when no population column is supplied. | - |

## Representations

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `umap_key` | `str` | `X_umap` | `basic` | Existing adata.obsm key containing the required UMAP embedding. | - |
| `pca_key` | `str` | `X_pca` | `advanced` | Existing optional adata.obsm key containing PCA coordinates; PCA is never recalculated. | - |
| `connectivities_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional adata.obsp connectivity key; otherwise use neighbors.connectivities_key then connectivities. | - |
| `sample_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional sample or case obs column counted as a cluster annotation in summary heatmaps. | - |
| `roi_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional ROI obs column counted as a cluster annotation in summary heatmaps. | - |
| `pca_dimensions` | `int` | `30` | `advanced` | Maximum number of stored PCA dimensions used for distance metrics. | - |

## Metric calculation

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `umap_k` | `int` | `15` | `advanced` | Number of nearest UMAP neighbours used for local separation and preservation metrics. | - |
| `graph_boundary_threshold` | `float` | `0.7` | `advanced` | Graph or UMAP purity below which a cell is classified as a boundary cell. | - |
| `core_purity_threshold` | `float` | `0.9` | `advanced` | Purity at or above which a cell is classified as a core cell. | - |
| `high_entropy_threshold` | `float` | `0.6` | `advanced` | Normalized local label entropy above which a cell is counted as high entropy. | - |
| `min_cluster_size` | `int` | `20` | `basic` | Clusters below this size remain visible but are flagged and may have unavailable metrics. | - |
| `min_component_size` | `int` | `5` | `advanced` | Minimum connected-component cell count used in substantial-component summaries. | - |
| `include_optional_metrics` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Calculate optional PCA-neighbour and UMAP-to-PCA preservation diagnostics. | - |

## Sweep metrics

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `persistence_jaccard_threshold` | `float` | `0.75` | `advanced` | Minimum best-match Jaccard used to count resolution-sweep support. | - |
| `transition_min_fraction` | `float` | `0.01` | `advanced` | Minimum source-cell fraction shown as an edge in sweep transition plots. | - |

## Scalability

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silhouette_max_cells` | `int` | `10000` | `advanced` | Maximum deterministic stratified sample used for each silhouette calculation. | - |
| `density_max_cells_per_cluster` | `int` | `5000` | `advanced` | Maximum deterministic sample per cluster used for UMAP density overlap. | - |
| `density_grid_size` | `int` | `64` | `advanced` | Number of bins per UMAP axis used by the scalable density-overlap approximation. | - |
| `random_seed` | `int` | `42` | `advanced` | Random seed used for every deterministic sampling decision. | - |

## Scoring

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `metric_config_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional YAML or JSON file overriding metric anchors, raw thresholds, inclusion, or weights. | - |

## Outputs

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `write_per_cell_metrics` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Write namespaced per-cell QC values as Parquet when a Parquet engine is available. | - |
| `write_annotated_h5ad` | `bool` | `False` | `basic` | Write a separate annotated AnnData copy; the input is never modified in place. | - |
